items.prompt:
To disassemble an object means to
A) take it apart into its pieces
B) paint it
C) make it bigger
D) throw it away
items.answer: A) take it apart into its pieces

steps: Disassemble means to take something apart.

items.prompt:
A tower of blocks can be taken apart and made into
A) a new object like a car
B) nothing
C) a different set of blocks
D) water
items.answer: A) a new object like a car

steps: The same blocks can become a new object.

items.prompt:
When you rebuild blocks into a new shape, the blocks
A) change into new blocks
B) stay the same
C) disappear
D) melt

steps: The pieces stay the same; the arrangement changes.

items.prompt:
You can build many things from the same blocks because the pieces can be
A) put together in different ways
B) eaten
C) only used once
D) never moved
items.answer: A) put together in different ways

items.prompt:
A student builds a bridge, then a house, from the same blocks. What changed?
A) The blocks became new
B) The way the blocks were put together
C) The blocks got smaller
D) Nothing at all
items.answer: B) The way the blocks were put together

steps: Only the arrangement changed, not the blocks.

items.prompt:
Snap-together bricks can be
A) taken apart and rebuilt into something else
B) used only once
C) never separated
D) turned into glass
items.answer: A) taken apart and rebuilt into something else

steps: Bricks come apart to be rebuilt.

items.prompt:
A student wants a car but has a block tower. The best thing to do is
A) take the tower apart and build a car from the blocks
B) buy new blocks
C) break the blocks
D) leave the tower
items.answer: A) take the tower apart and build a car from the blocks

steps: The same blocks can be rebuilt into a car.

items.prompt:
The evidence that a set of pieces can make different objects is that
A) the same pieces built two different objects
B) the pieces disappeared
C) each object used new pieces
D) nothing changed
items.answer: A) the same pieces built two different objects

steps: Reusing the same pieces for two objects is the evidence.
